name: 8bit-pixel-art
title_zh: 把照片或一句话蒸馏成稀疏 8-bit 像素艺术
tagline_zh: Instagram/编辑风格，软边粗像素主体落在干净纸面上；或全出血构图。自动砍掉低价值细节，只留主导物，绝不硬边。
tagline_en: Turn a brief or photo into sparse 8-bit art: soft coarse pixels on clean paper, or full-bleed when needed. Drops.
desc_en: Create sparse abstract Instagram/editorial 8-bit pixel artwork from a natural-language brief, or distill an uploaded photo into either a soft-edged coarse-pixel subject cluster on a clean portrait paper field or an intentional edge-to-edge pixel composition when the source calls for full bleed. Use for `create` and `fuse`; prioritize dominant subjects, omit low-value detail, and never use a hard p
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是先做视觉优先级排序——先识别主导物，再决定软边或全出血，最后才像素化。
why_en: Not a filter stack—it prioritizes dominant subjects first, then chooses soft-edge or full-bleed, then pixelates. Output feels.
limit_zh: 只认两种输入：自然语言 brief 或单张照片。不做多图合成、不做动画、不输出透明背景 PNG。像素块尺寸固定为 8×。
limit_en: Only accepts a text brief or one photo. No multi-image compositing, no animation, no transparent PNG. Pixel size fixed at 8×8—no finer/coarser.
